title: A Interior for the Undertow
author: Casper Underhill
blurb: Yara Amberdale, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
